english.title: Parent knowingly failed to cause child to attend alternative education provision regularly
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the parent of a child of compulsory school age, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD'S NAME..), and knowing that the child was failing to attend regularly at the place at which alternative education was provided in accordance with arrangements under section 19 of the Education Act 1996, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), failed without reasonable justification to cause

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]]_

to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 444(1A), (8A) and 444ZA of the Education Act 1996.
